title: ExitCodeEntry
description: Metadata for one exit code a command may emit. Used as the value type in the exit_codes map; the integer exit code is the map key, not a field in this object.

name.description: The named constant for this exit code (e.g. 'SUCCESS', 'ARG_ERROR'). For framework codes 0-13, derived from ExitCode enum if omitted. For command-specific codes 79-125, must be provided by the command author

description.description: Present-tense description of the condition under which this code is emitted. Written for agent consumption — be specific about what state the system is in

retryable.description: True if re-running the exact same call unchanged may succeed; implies no side effects occurred. False when the caller must first correct input, credentials, or state. Must be false whenever side_effects is 'partial' or 'complete'

side_effects.description: Extent of externally visible work committed before this exit. 'none' = nothing was written; 'partial' = some writes occurred; 'complete' = all intended writes occurred

items.description: One error.code value the command emits in its response envelope under this exit code

error_codes.description: The error.code values the command emits under this exit code, so an agent learns them before the first call. Absent means the command does not declare them, not that there are none; an empty array means this exit carries no error.code
